totals.label: Cash totals for the current filter

actions.viewLabel: View daily close details for {{store}} on {{date}}

empty.title: No daily closes match these filters
empty.hint: Daily closes saved before this feature launched only show full details after the matching POS terminal is upgraded.

errors.loadFailed: Failed to load daily closes. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view daily closes, or to view this store.
errors.invalidQuery: Invalid filters: the business date range can be at most 93 days and the start date cannot be after the end date.
errors.detailFailed: Failed to load the daily close details. Please try again.
errors.detailNotFound: This daily close does not exist or is outside the stores you can view.
errors.loadStoresFailed: Failed to load the store list

validation.rangeRequired: Please choose a valid business date range
validation.rangeReversed: The start date cannot be after the end date

notice.title: Backfilled record
notice.cashOnly: This daily close was saved before the POS upgrade. Only the three cash figures (expected, counted, difference) could be recovered from the operation log; there is no tender summary or cash count breakdown.
notice.traceOnly: This daily close was saved before the POS upgrade. Only the save record (store, terminal, cashier, saved time) remains; there are no amounts.
notice.inferred: The business date was inferred from the saved time (store local time).
notice.autoComplete: Once this terminal is upgraded, the full details saved on the machine will be uploaded automatically and replace this record.

recon.title: Cash reconciliation
recon.formula: Difference = counted cash − expected net cash. Negative is short, positive is over.
recon.noAmountNote: No amount: this record has no cash data, so the cash difference cannot be calculated.
